correctness.rationale: The 128-subset inclusion-exclusion identity evaluates every ternary Fourier character as an integer. The GL(3,2) automorphism group with frequency negation partitions the 729 balanced frequencies into 12 exhaustively enumerated classes; all class multipliers are nonzero and the other 1458 characters vanish by global-colour translation. A separate direct exact Z[omega] DFT over all 2187 colourings reproduces each level and multiplicity, 882 valid colourings, Parseval and the least multiplier 9. Convolution diagonalization supplies rank 729, norm 1/9 and condition number 98, for the precise unnormalized domain. Both checkers were rerun successfully from current package material.

value.rationale: The unique seven-point Steiner triple system is a canonical smallest non-2-colourable hypergraph. Its weak three-colouring indicator is a natural additive-noise kernel, and the 12 symmetry classes and six exact nonzero Fourier levels supply a complete unknown-from-background recovery/invertibility invariant, including sharp stability 1/9. This is a motivated structural finite classification, not merely the known number of colourings or an arbitrary parameter slice; larger systems and other palettes are explicitly left open.
